samples_to_threshold_accuracy.note: Candidate consumed full budget without reaching threshold

criterion_1.text: Reaches 99% test accuracy on modular addition (mod p for p in [5, 31]) using less than 50% of the baseline's compute-to-threshold
criterion_1.evidence: Test accuracy 1.9% — 97 percentage points below the 99% threshold

criterion_2.text: Maintains performance across all tested primes without per-prime tuning
criterion_2.evidence: Performance below random chance for 8 of 9 primes; only p=7 marginally above random (16% vs 14.3% chance)

criterion_3.text: Achieves higher test accuracy per FLOP than the baseline across the full compute budget
criterion_3.evidence: Candidate 1.9% test accuracy vs baseline 45.3% — baseline is 23.7x better

criterion_1.text: Gradient norms exceed 50 for 3 consecutive checkpoints
criterion_1.evidence: Maximum gradient norm was 0.079 at epoch 1; norms declined to 0.005 by epoch 10000

criterion_2.text: Test accuracy does not exceed 60% after consuming 50% of the compute budget
criterion_2.evidence: Test accuracy at epoch 5000 (50% budget): 2.2%, far below the 60% threshold

criterion_3.text: Loss does not decrease below initial loss after consuming 20% of the compute budget
criterion_3.evidence: Initial loss 3.779, loss at epoch 2000 (20% budget): 2.688 — loss did decrease

observations.plateau_description: Model reached ~20% train accuracy and ~2% test accuracy by epoch 100. For the remaining 9,900 epochs, both metrics oscillated within noise with zero improvement trend.
observations.loss_trajectory: Dropped from 3.78 to 2.69 by epoch 100, then flatlined at ~2.70 for the remaining 9,900 epochs
observations.gradient_collapse: Gradient norms declined monotonically from 0.079 to 0.005, indicating vanishing learning signal
observations.train_test_gap: Train accuracy (~20%) exceeded test accuracy (~2%) by 10x, indicating the model memorized a subset of training patterns without learning generalizable modular structure
observations.per_prime_analysis: 8 of 9 primes below random chance. The model appears to have learned a biased but non-functional output distribution rather than modular arithmetic.

reject_reasons: Test accuracy 1.9% is 23.7x worse than baseline (45.3%)
Failure criterion #2 triggered: test accuracy 2.2% at 50% budget, threshold is 60%
Model performs below random chance on 8 of 9 tested primes
Complete training stagnation from epoch 100 onward — the piecewise fold architecture failed to learn modular arithmetic structure
20% train accuracy suggests partial memorization of training data distribution without learning the underlying modular operation
